integrity: The proof separates the published ingredients from the new counting consequence: Koponen supplies the constraint definition, antichain property, free-amalgamation Fraïssé classes, and pairwise nonisomorphism; the orbit threshold and exact factorial gap are derived explicitly. A finite verifier independently checks the finite automorphism counts and sample non-embeddings.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to Koponen's constraint family and does not claim an analogous formula for arbitrary forbidden-antichain Fraïssé classes.
The originality assessment cannot exclude unpublished folklore or results indexed under substantially different terminology.
title: Exact arity separation in Koponen's continuum of homogeneous simple structures
